top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a quantitative, falsifiable 2011 continuum-model prediction of flat bands at a magic twist angle (MacDonald and Bistritzer, a joint paper) and the 2018 experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states in that regime (Jarillo-Herrero), since reproduced by independent groups and extended to multilayers and moire TMDs. Worded without any claim on the pairing mechanism, the citation does not depend on the open question. Three names fit the allocation; the experimental credit is thin (Cao, Fatemi and others fall outside), but widening it would remove one author of the decisive prediction. P002 (Katori, Ye) is a mature, cleanly attributed, independently confirmed invention and my clear fallback, ahead of no award, but I weight field-opening discovery with a tested prediction above enabling capability this year.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; no documented tie to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer, Katori or Ye. My circuit-QED field proximity (B058) and Chalmers/WACQT links are not on this slate.
